Subject: Re: [ILUG] rebuilding mandrake packages

Gavin McCullagh wrote:
> Hi,
> 
> does anyone have a handy link to a doc on how to rebuild packages on
> mandrake?
> 
> I'm used to using apt-get source, apt-get build-dep and debuild on debian.
> Does anyone know is there a similarly convenient method on Mandrake?
> 
> Gavin
> 
To get the source automatically like with apt-get source
I think you need to use yumdownloader --source ...
which comes with the yumutils package (hmm mandrake
probably doesn't use yum?).

to build a source package `rpmbuild` is the command you want
(part of the rpm-build package).

Pádraig.
